summary: Forest fire tower moved in 1969 from three miles east of West Point to near Saluda for a Route 33 widening; sold at auction with removal required in 2003; the list marks it gone.

facts.status_note: Sold at auction in January 2003 with removal required; the lookout list marks it gone; no source describes the site now

events.note: Moved from three miles east of West Point to a new location near Saluda, because Route 33 was to be widened
Sold at auction with removal required

evidence.supports: tower relocated from three miles east of West Point to a new location near Saluda
evidence.quote: The re-location of a Forest Fire Lookout Tower from a point three miles east of West Point to a new location near Saluda

evidence.supports: move needed because Route 33 would be widened; tower on the proposed right-of-way
evidence.quote: It was necessary to move the tower because Route 33 will be improved and widened and the tower was standing on the proposed highway right-of-way.

evidence.supports: new site seven miles closer to Lancaster County
evidence.quote: has placed the tower seven miles closer to Lancaster County

evidence.supports: more effective coverage of forest acreage in all directions
evidence.quote: The new location will result in more effective coverage of the forest acreage in all directions.

evidence.supports: watchman contacts the other tower to get bearings from both towers
evidence.quote: the lookout watchman will contact the man in the other tower in order to secure degree readings from both towers

evidence.supports: when either tower spots smoke, the watchman contacts the other tower
evidence.quote: when either tower spots a smoke, the lookout watchman will contact the man in the other tower

evidence.supports: the other tower the item names is the Miskimon tower
forest warden can drive directly to the fire
evidence.quote: enabling the forest warden to save valuable time and drive directly to the fire to investigate it
January 2003: The lookout tower sold at auction with removal required.

evidence.supports: page lists the agency (spelled Viginia on the page)
lookout list entry Middlesex: coordinates 37.61046, -76.64281; status Gone
Saluda is the county seat of Middlesex County
evidence.quote: Saluda is a census-designated place (CDP) in and the county seat of Middlesex County

evidence.supports: the agency's own site uses the name Virginia Department of Forestry
evidence.quote: VFLEP is one of the Virginia Department of Forestry

corrections.why: The misspelling 'Viginia' is on the Forest Lookouts page (cite 1) and was copied into our record. The agency's own site spells it Virginia.

sources.title: Middlesex (Saluda), Forest Lookouts (quoting Rappahannock Record, March 6, 1969)
Virginia, Forest Fire Lookout Association lookout list
Welcome to the Virginia Department of Forestry

notes_for_editor: The 1969 move and the 2003 auction both come from one Forest Lookouts page; the 2003 line has no outside source. No original build date, height or design appears in the sources read, so the record keeps height and built unset. The list marks it gone; no source describes the site now. Agency spelling corrected from the page's 'Viginia'. No photos found.
